claim.scope_statement: For fixed F and g>=3, all smooth proper geometrically connected genus-g curves X/F with rank Jac(X)(F)<=g-3 have a uniform explicit bound depending only on g and [F:Q]. Over Q the bound is 84g^2-98g+28. No unrestricted-rank uniformity is claimed.
